about: The plain categories of the user-question draft (docs/tracking/USER_QUESTION_DRAFT_20261127.md, 2026-11-27): each with the help text a person sees and the I-ADOPT constraint types behind it (the completed table's names). Every type is in exactly one category.

categories.name: conditions
categories.help: Under what conditions it is measured or counted: at 25 °C, at normal air pressure, under an ISO test method, free of pests.

categories.name: state or form
categories.help: The state or form of the thing: dissolved, dry, frozen, stagnant, as snow or ice, resting.

categories.name: part or layer
categories.help: A part or layer of the thing: its surface, its upper layer, its leaves, a thin film of it.

categories.name: measured from or towards
categories.help: A point it is measured from, or a direction: above ground, relative to north, relative to the sensor, northward, downward.

categories.name: place or area
categories.help: A place or area it is limited to: near the coast, in the European Union, within 5 m of a road.

categories.name: time or period
categories.help: A time or period: currently, at night, over the survey period, chronic.

categories.name: rate (per something)
categories.help: Per something: per hour, per person, per district, per square metre.

categories.name: how often
categories.help: How often it is measured or reported: daily, hourly, monthly.

categories.name: cause
categories.help: What causes it: due to fire, due to heat, caused by flooding.

categories.name: process or event
categories.help: A process or event during which it is measured: during digestion, during photosynthesis, a 50-year storm, the latest test.

categories.name: where it comes from
categories.help: Its source or origin: from road traffic, from a power plant, from the air.

categories.name: rule, limit, rank or rating
categories.help: A rule that picks which value counts, a limit, a rank or a rating: the highest, above a detection limit, primary, five star, between 1 and 10.

categories.name: about the person
categories.help: About the people involved: their role (patient, tenant), age, education, relationship (mother).

categories.name: who did it, or what for
categories.help: Who carried it out, or what it is for: by an accredited laboratory, for influenza screening.

categories.name: about the sample or material
categories.help: About the sample or material: its purity, its resistivity (deionized water), its volume, its size or diameter, a wavelength range, a minimum temperature, its material, what it is made of, its quantity, its class.
